entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I hope you can help. I bought this jersey a while ago, and I just... I feel so bad about this, but I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the wrong size. I kept telling myself I'd fit into it, but it's just too tight across the shoulders. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I really needed this money back for some other things coming up. I feel terrible asking so late.
I understand completely, no need to feel bad at all. Let's see what we can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-886-113-09. I was hoping I could either get a refund or maybe an exchange for a larger size if it's not too much trouble.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered 79 days ago.
Oh no, is that too long? I knew I should have called sooner. I'm so sorry.
Not at all. For a standard item like this jersey, our VeloFit return policy is 90 days. You are well within the window for a full refund or an exchange.
Really? Oh, thank goodness! That is such a relief. You have no idea. Thank you so much, David.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file right now. You can use that to send the jersey back for a full refund. Would you prefer that, or would you like me to process an exchange for the next size up?
You know what, a refund would be best for now. Thank you for making this so easy.
Of course. The email is on its way. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
